lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The chair is at the bottom of the stack, facing away, and it turns around, which is the worst thing it could have done.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: Oh, that is me. That is genuinely me. I did not expect it to be so obviously me.

lines.speaker: the_chair
lines.text: Auditor. Eleven years, four commendations, and one query. Sit down; there are four chairs and three of them are held by instruments, and instruments do not sit.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You have been paid every quarter for two hundred and eighty-one years.

lines.speaker: the_chair
lines.text: I have been paid rent. It is my property. I am not being obtuse with you, that is simply the legal position and it has never once been contested, because nobody could find it to contest it.

lines.speaker: the_chair
lines.text: You found it. I want to be clear that I think that is admirable. It does not change the position, and the position is the only thing in this room that has ever mattered.
